script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'phase-a-fixes',
  description: 'Fix round for phase A review findings: migrations (db-engineer) + payments service cleanup (fixer)',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fix' }],
}
const COMMON = `You are a lane in a timed build. Working directory ./app. Kit files: ../BRIEF.md (source of truth), ../SPEC.md, ../DECISIONS.md. The brief wins over CLAUDE.md where SPEC.md says so (error body {error: string}, no required idempotency key, no webhook_events, bigint sen, status never stored, seed = npm run seed). One simple command per Bash call; never npm i; never commit; DB commands via bash ../scripts/with-db.sh <cmd>. Dev server already runs on :3000 (do not touch it).`
const SCHEMA = { type: 'object', properties: {
  status: { type: 'string', enum: ['done', 'partial', 'blocked'] }, files_changed: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
  checks_run: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, assumptions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, notes: { type: 'string' } },
  required: ['status', 'files_changed', 'checks_run', 'assumptions'] }

const db = agent(`${COMMON}
Task T1/T4 fix round (db-engineer). Migrations 0001 and 0002 are NOT committed yet, so edit them IN PLACE (supabase/migrations/20261026000001_schema.sql and 20261026000002_money.sql). Files you may edit: those two migrations, prisma/schema.prisma (db pull only), supabase/tests/money_smoke.sql.
Apply exactly these reviewer findings:
1. 0001: per-schema "alter default privileges ... revoke execute on functions from public" does not remove the global PUBLIC execute default. Add the global form: alter default privileges for role postgres revoke execute on functions from public; (keep the explicit per-function revokes).
2. 0001: the payments reason CHECK passes when reason is NULL. Use coalesce(char_length(btrim(reason)), 0) >= 5 for rejected/voided. (tests/db/constraints.test.ts has a failing test for this; it must pass.)
3. 0001: gateway_bills_guard: make it ENABLE ALWAYS like the others, add a BEFORE TRUNCATE guard, and when old.status = 'paid' reject any change to paid_at, transaction_id, transaction_status (a paid bill never goes back, R34).
4. 0001: invoices amount check: rent invoices may be 0 sen (generateSchedule can round a tiny last period to 0, and the brief says lease creation stores EXACTLY the schedule). Use check (amount_sen > 0 or (kind = 'rent' and amount_sen = 0)) — deposit stays > 0. Make sure allocate_payment never inserts a 0-sen allocation (allocation rows keep amount_sen > 0).
5. 0002: apply_gateway_callback must ALSO insert an audit row 'payment.approved' (actor_id null, entity_id = the new payment id, details {source:'gateway', bill_id}) in addition to gateway_bill.paid (R25 "every approval").
6. 0002: reusing a slip_path already attached to another payment must be P0400 'Slip already used' (route table lists 400 for invalid input), not P0409.
7. 0002: add at the top of each lease-locking function a guard: if current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' then raise exception using errcode = 'P0409', message = 'Unsupported isolation level'; with a comment "-- D7: the cap is computed after the lease lock; READ COMMITTED gives each statement a fresh snapshot after the wait".
Then: bash ../scripts/db-reset.sh; npx prisma db pull --force; npx prisma generate; npx tsc --noEmit; bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/db tests/rls tests/storage (report pass/fail counts, all must pass); then npm run seed (the DB is freshly reset; the seed password in .env.local is now quoted, RentDemo#2026) and show its summary; then psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/tests/money_smoke.sql against the DB (it rolls back) and show the tail.`,
  { agentType: 'db-engineer', label: 'T1/T4-fix:db-engineer', phase: 'Fix', schema: SCHEMA })

const be = agent(`${COMMON}
Task T5 fix round (fixer). Files you may edit: src/server/services/payments.ts, src/server/services/serialize.ts only.
Findings to fix:
1. src/server/services/payments.ts ~92-100: requireRecorder runs outside the try/catch that removes an uploaded slip, so a 404/403 on the lease leaves the uploaded file behind (R20 "If recording fails after the upload, the file must not be left behind"). Restructure: load the caller first; wrap authorization + validation + the record call in the cleanup try; on failure remove the slip ONLY when slipPath is a string starting with '<caller.member.orgId>/' (the caller's own org folder — never delete in another org's folder), contains no '..', and no payment row references it (existing guard). Rethrow the original error.
2. payments.ts 36-39: asStatus duplicates asPaymentStatus in serialize.ts 61-64 — export asPaymentStatus from serialize.ts and use it.
Do not change behaviour otherwise. Done means: npx tsc --noEmit and npx eslint . --max-warnings=0 clean (show output).`,
  { agentType: 'fixer', label: 'T5-fix:fixer', phase: 'Fix', schema: SCHEMA })

return await Promise.all([db, be])

checks_run: bash ../scripts/db-reset.sh -> both migrations applied, 'Finished supabase db reset on branch main.' (run twice; the second reset was needed before seeding)
npx prisma db pull --force -> introspected 37 models (only the usual RLS / check / exclusion warnings)
npx prisma generate -> Generated Prisma Client (7.10.1)

bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/db tests/rls tests/storage -> 4 files, 531 tests: 530 passed, 1 FAILED. The failure is tests/db/constraints.test.ts:77 'invoices.amount_sen 0 is rejected'. It inserts a RENT invoice of 0 sen and expects 23514, which finding 4 now allows on purpose. The NULL-reason test (line 286), which finding 2 targeted, now passes.

npm run seed -> first try refused with 'Database is not fresh' because the test run leaves orgs behind (the append-only audit_log references them). After a fresh reset: 'Seed complete.', 2 orgs (Northwind Properties, Beta Realty), 7 accounts (manager@northwind.test, staff@northwind.test, aisyah@northwind.test, ben@northwind.test, probe@northwind.test, manager@beta.test, chen@beta.test), 4 leases, 37 invoices, 3 allocations, Aisyah cash + bank-transfer payments approved. The DB is left in this seeded state.

bash ../scripts/with-db.sh psql ... -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/tests/money_smoke.sql -> every step ok, ends in ROLLBACK. New checks: 2d slip reused -> P0400; 9c2 gateway payment.approved audited (actor null, source gateway); 9c3 paid bill transaction_id frozen -> P0409; 9j2 no allocation on the 0-sen rent invoice; 9j3 0-sen deposit -> 23514. Audit tail: gateway_bill.created=3, gateway_bill.failed=1, gateway_bill.paid=3, payment.approved=6, payment.recorded=3, payment.voided=1
psql probe: begin isolation level serializable + private.create_gateway_bill(...) -> ERROR 'Unsupported isolation level' (guard works)
psql probe pg_default_acl: the global postgres function default is now {postgres=X/postgres}, so PUBLIC no longer gets execute
assumptions: CONFLICT, needs the lead or test-authz: tests/db/constraints.test.ts:77 ('invoices.amount_sen 0 is rejected') goes directly against finding 4 and now fails. That file belongs to test-authz, so I did not edit it. Suggested fix: expect 23514 for a 0-sen DEPOSIT invoice or a -1 sen rent invoice, and add a positive test that a 0-sen rent invoice is accepted.

Finding 7: I put the READ COMMITTED guard in the four functions that take the lease lock: record_payment, lock_payment_for_manager, create_gateway_bill and apply_gateway_callback. approve/reject/void get it because their first statement calls lock_payment_for_manager; I did not paste it into each of them separately. allocate_payment has no guard because it never takes a lock (its callers already hold one).

Finding 6: besides the pre-check, the ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING fallback in record_payment (a race on slip_path from another lease of the same org) now also raises P0400 'Slip already used', so both paths give the same answer.

Finding 3: the paid-bill freeze covers paid_at, transaction_id and transaction_status (plus the earlier status-forward and immutable-facts checks). updated_at may still change. The TRUNCATE guard reuses private.gateway_bills_guard (tg_op <> 'UPDATE' -> P0409 'Gateway bills are never deleted'). Both gateway_bills triggers are ENABLE ALWAYS.

Finding 4: only kind='rent' may be 0 sen; deposit, gateway_bills, payments and payment_allocations stay > 0. allocate_payment already skipped invoices with unpaid <= 0, so no code change was needed there, only a comment. The smoke test proves it with a 0-sen rent invoice.
Finding 1: added `alter default privileges for role postgres revoke execute on functions from public;` next to the per-schema revokes and kept every explicit per-function revoke.
Finding 5: the gateway payment.approved audit row uses details {source:'gateway', bill_id} exactly as specified, with no amount and no lease_id, unlike the manual approval row.
result.notes:
Status is partial only because 1 of 531 tests fails: tests/db/constraints.test.ts:77 expects a 0-sen rent invoice to be rejected, and finding 4 now allows it on purpose. That test file belongs to test-authz, so I did not touch it.

Migrations, both edited in place and not committed:
- 20261026000001_schema.sql
- 20261026000002_money.sql

Changes, by finding:
1. 0001: added the global `alter default privileges for role postgres revoke execute on functions from public`. pg_default_acl confirms PUBLIC is gone.
2. 0001: the payments reason CHECK now uses `coalesce(char_length(btrim(reason)), 0) >= 5`, so a NULL reason fails it.
3. 0001: the gateway_bills row trigger is ENABLE ALWAYS, there is a new ENABLE ALWAYS BEFORE TRUNCATE trigger, and a paid bill can no longer change paid_at, transaction_id or transaction_status (P0409 'A paid gateway bill cannot change').
4. 0001: the invoice amount check is now `check (amount_sen > 0 or (kind = 'rent' and amount_sen = 0))`.
5. 0002: apply_gateway_callback also writes a 'payment.approved' audit row: actor null, entity = the new payment id, details {source:'gateway', bill_id}.
6. 0002: 'Slip already used' is now P0400 in both the pre-check and the conflict fallback.
7. 0002: READ COMMITTED guard (P0409 'Unsupported isolation level') with the D7 comment, in the functions that lock the lease.

SQLSTATEs per function after this round:
- record_payment: P0409 isolation level, P0404 lease not found or not staff/manager of its org, P0409 idempotency key reused with a different payload, P0400 method/amount/received_at/cash-with-slip/slip not found/slip already used, P0422 over the cap.
- lock_payment_for_manager (and through it approve/reject/void): P0409 isolation level, P0404 payment not found or not a manager of its org.
- approve_payment: P0409 not pending, P0422 over the remaining balance.
- reject_payment: P0400 reason under 5 characters, P0409 not pending.
- void_payment: P0400 reason under 5 characters, P0409 not approved.
- allocate_payment: P0404 payment not found, P0409 payment not approved.
- create_gateway_bill: P0409 isolation level, P0404 lease not found or caller not its tenant, P0422 nothing is due.
- apply_gateway_callback: P0409 isolation level, P0404 unknown bill, P0400 paid or paid_at missing, P0422 paid amount does not match the bill.
- Triggers: P0409 for an update/delete/truncate on audit_log, payments, payment_allocations or gateway_bills that the guard blocks, and for changes to the immutable lease and invoice columns.

RLS matrix (unchanged this round):
- anon: nothing on any table.
- authenticated, SELECT only:
  - organizations: members, plus tenants of the org.
  - memberships: manager/staff of the org.
  - units: manager/staff, plus a tenant of a lease on that unit.
  - tenants: manager/staff, plus their own row.
  - leases, invoices, gateway_bills, payments, payment_allocations: manager/staff of the org, plus the lease's own tenant.
  - audit_log: managers only.
- The only client UPDATE is a tenant changing their own phone (column grant on phone, plus USING and WITH CHECK user_id = auth.uid()).
- There is no INSERT or DELETE policy on any public table.
- Storage, bucket payment-slips: INSERT and SELECT for manager/staff of the org named in the path's first folder.

Packages needed: none.

Note for the lead: running tests/db leaves org rows the seed cannot work around (audit_log is append-only), so the gate order has to be reset, then seed, and a reset again before seeding if tests ran in between.

assumptions: Cause 1: in recordPayment (payments.ts), requireRecorder ran before the cleanup try, so a lease 404/403 left the uploaded slip in storage. Fix: recordPayment now loads the caller first, and the lease authorization, validation and record_payment call all sit inside the try. On any failure the catch removes the slip and rethrows the original error.

The catch calls removeOrphanSlip(rawSlip, caller.member.orgId), i.e. the caller's own org folder. The existing guards still apply: isOwnOrgSlipPath requires the '<orgId>/' prefix and no '..' or backslash, and the 'no payment references it' check is kept. Before, cleanup used the lease's org_id, which was only known after authorization.
A caller with no member row (a pure tenant) gets no cleanup, because there is no own-org folder to delete from. A tenant cannot upload to a staff folder anyway.

To get the caller before authorization, requireRecorder now takes a Caller instead of a ctx and returns {orgId, leaseId}. authorizeRecordPayment loads the caller itself, so its behaviour is unchanged.

Cause 2: asStatus in payments.ts was a copy of asPaymentStatus in serialize.ts. I exported asPaymentStatus from serialize.ts (line 61), deleted the local copy, and switched all call sites in payments.ts to it.

Not in my files, so not touched: the POST /api/leases/:leaseId/payments route calls authorizeRecordPayment before reading the body, so a slip uploaded to a lease that fails that check is never cleaned up by recordPayment. The route handler would need its own cleanup. Behaviour is otherwise unchanged. I ran only tsc and eslint, not the payment tests.

summary: Fix round for phase A review findings: migrations (db-engineer) + payments service cleanup (fixer)
